description_en: Notifies OSS to initialize a multipart upload event
description_zh: 通知OSS初始化一个Multipart Upload事件
name: InitiateMultipartUpload

parameters.help_en: The name of the bucket in which to initialize a multipart upload event
parameters.help_zh: 初始化一个Multipart Upload事件的Bucket名称
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The name of the object for which to initialize a multipart upload event
parameters.help_zh: 初始化一个Multipart Upload事件的Object名称
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the encoding type for the returned key. URL encoding is supported. Keys use UTF-8 characters, but XML 1.0 does not support parsing certain control characters, such as characters with ASCII values from 0 to 10. For keys that contain control characters not supported by the XML 1.0 standard, you can specify encoding-type to encode the returned key.
Default value: null
Valid values: url
parameters.help_zh:
指定对返回的Key进行编码，目前支持URL编码。Key使用UTF-8字符，但XML 1.0标准不支持解析一些控制字符，例如ASCII值从0到10的字符。对于Key中包含XML
                              1.0标准不支持的控制字符，可以通过指定encoding-type对返回的Key进行编码。
默认值：无
可选值：url
parameters.name: encoding_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to overwrite an existing object with the same name during the InitiateMultipartUpload operation. When the destination bucket is in the enabled or suspended versioning state, the x-oss-forbid-overwrite request header is invalid, and objects with the same name can be overwritten.
If you do not specify x-oss-forbid-overwrite or set x-oss-forbid-overwrite to false, an existing object with the same name can be overwritten.
If you set x-oss-forbid-overwrite to true, an existing object with the same name cannot be overwritten.

Setting the x-oss-forbid-overwrite request header degrades QPS processing performance. If you need to use the x-oss-forbid-overwrite request header for a large number of operations (QPS > 1000), contact technical support to avoid impact on your business
parameters.help_zh:
指定InitiateMultipartUpload操作时是否覆盖同名Object。当目标Bucket处于已开启或已暂停的版本控制状态时，x-oss-forbid-overwrite请求Header设置无效，即允许覆盖同名Object。
不指定x-oss-forbid-overwrite或者指定x-oss-forbid-overwrite为false时，表示允许覆盖同名Object。
指定x-oss-forbid-overwrite为true时，表示禁止覆盖同名Object。

设置x-oss-forbid-overwrite请求Header会导致QPS处理性能下降，如果您有大量的操作需要使用x-oss-forbid-overwrite请求Header（QPS>1000），请联系技术支持，避免影响您的业务
parameters.name: x_oss_forbid_overwrite

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the storage class of the object.
For a bucket of any storage class, if you specify this value when uploading an object, the object is stored as the specified storage class. For example, if you upload an object to an Infrequent Access (IA) bucket and set x-oss-storage-class to Standard, the object is stored as Standard.
Valid values:

Standard
IA: Infrequent Access
Archive
ColdArchive: Cold Archive

For more information about storage classes, see **https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html**
parameters.help_zh:
指定Object的存储类型。
对于任意存储类型Bucket，如果上传Object时指定该值，则此次上传的Object将存储为指定的类型。例如在IA类型的Bucket中上传Object时，如果指定x-oss-storage-class为Standard，则该Object直接存储为Standard类型。
取值：

Standard：标准存储
IA：低频访问
Archive：归档存储
ColdArchive：冷归档存储

关于存储类型的更多信息，请参见**https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/51374.html**
parameters.name: x_oss_storage_class

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the tags of the object. You can set multiple tags at the same time, for example: TagA=A&TagB=B
The key and value must be URL-encoded first. If an item does not contain `=`, the value is treated as an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
指定Object的标签，可同时设置多个标签，例如： TagA=A&TagB=B
Key和Value需要先进行URL编码，如果某项没有`=`，则看作Value为空字符串
parameters.name: x_oss_tagging

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the server-side encryption method used when uploading each part of the object.
Valid values: AES256, KMS, or SM4
Before using the KMS encryption algorithm, you must activate Key Management Service (KMS).


After you specify this parameter, the response header returns this parameter. OSS encrypts and stores each uploaded part. When you download the object, the response header contains x-oss-server-side-encryption, and the value is set to the encryption algorithm of the object
parameters.help_zh:
指定上传该Object的每个part时使用的服务器端加密方式。
取值：AES256、KMS或SM4
使用KMS加密算法前，您需要先开通密钥管理服务KMS。


指定此参数后，在响应头中会返回此参数，OSS会对上传的每个part进行加密编码存储。当下载该Object时，响应头中会包含x-oss-server-side-encryption，且该值会被设置成此Object的加密算法
parameters.name: x_oss_server_side_encryption

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the encryption algorithm for the object. If this option is not specified, the object is encrypted by using AES256. This option is valid only when x-oss-server-side-encryption is set to KMS.
Valid values: SM4
parameters.help_zh:
指定Object的加密算法。若未指定此选项，表明Object使用AES256加密算法。此选项仅当x-oss-server-side-encryption为KMS时有效。
取值：SM4
parameters.name: x_oss_server_side_data_encryption

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the customer master key (CMK) hosted in KMS.
This parameter is valid only when x-oss-server-side-encryption is set to KMS
parameters.help_zh:
表示KMS托管的用户主密钥。
该参数在x-oss-server-side-encryption值为KMS时有效
parameters.name: x_oss_server_side_encryption_key_id
